component.name: PS HID Bridge
component.summary: Use the mouse and keyboard of this computer on the PlayStation

description.p: Forwards mouse and keyboard, encrypted over the network, to a small board on the PlayStation's USB port. The picture comes in via Remote Play (for example chiaki-ng).

ul.li: Switch with a key combination, mouse button, double tap, hold, or automatically with a window rule
Emergency stop combination that always releases the devices
Status view with latency measurement to the board
